question: Should OpenClaw accept this Wave 2+ modular dashboard roadmap as a bundled Control UI product direction, and which parts must stay plugin/ClawHub or wait for core API, storage, or security decisions?
rationale: The roadmap adds new user-facing dashboard composition, persistent widget/workspace state, Gateway RPC/event surfaces, agent tools, and untrusted browser widget execution, which require maintainer product and security intent beyond source inspection.

options.title: Review and sponsor the stack
options.body: Proceed through the linked PRs in order, requiring explicit storage, upgrade, security, and proof fixes before merge.

options.title: Narrow to core seams
options.body: Approve only generic plugin/API gaps and ask dashboard-specific workspaces/widgets to stay external until separately sponsored.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Keep the roadmap open but pause or close the linked implementation PRs if this is not current product work.

recommendation.title: Review and sponsor the stack
recommendation.body: Proceed through the linked PRs in order, requiring explicit storage, upgrade, security, and proof fixes before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest recent history signal for the Control UI and plugin-tab seam this roadmap builds on.
